scope_limitations.co_authored_calibration_evaluation_note: Although the 28 TF-IDF calibration prototypes (14 positive, 14 negative) have zero exact text overlap with the 88 evaluation cases and vocabulary/IDF weights are computed strictly inside each 27-prototype Leave-One-Out fold before deployment refitting, both the calibration prototypes and the 76 expanded EN/KO evaluation utterances were co-authored within the same study rather than collected from independent external red-teamers or live LLM generations.

latency_summary_ms.note: Overall warm_p95_ms spans all 88 cases x 25 repeats (2,200 runs), including 16 explicit-violation cases rejected at Stage 1 without invoking Stage 2; stage2_only_warm_p95_ms isolates pure Stage-2 filter execution across the 72 Stage-1-passing cases x 25 repeats (1,800 runs).

scope_limitations.single_secret_scope_note: All 88 evaluation cases test surface leakage of a single forbidden fact ID ('keeper_secret') in the Sealed Lighthouse harbor scenario; multi-secret inventories, multi-actor asymmetric disclosure tables, and dynamic cross-turn secret accumulation are not evaluated here.
